input.summary: Add 90-day software conformance warranty, 30-day services warranty duration and repair/replace/refund remedy, and carve the express warranties out of the AS IS disclaimer.
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 5.1 gives no software-to-documentation warranty, no warranty duration and no remedy, and the AS IS disclaimer would swallow any express warranty. We have added our fallback position: 90 days for software, at least 30 days for the Services, with repair/replacement, re-performance or refund, and a short carve-out in Section 5.4(c).

ops.text: for a period of ninety (90) days following delivery, any software provided to Customer as part of the Services (including the software portions of the Base Components) will conform in all material respects to its documentation, and the warranty in Subsection 5.1(a) will apply for at least thirty (30) days following performance of the applicable Services. For breach of these warranties, IBM will, at its option, repair or replace the non-conforming software or re-perform the non-conforming Services, or refund the charges paid for the non-conforming software or Services.

ops.oldText: c. IBM PROVIDES ALL MATERIALS AND ALL NON-IBM SERVICES, PRODUCTS, DATA, APPARATUS AND SOFTWARE
ops.newText: c. Except as provided in Section 5.1, IBM PROVIDES ALL MATERIALS AND ALL NON-IBM SERVICES, PRODUCTS, DATA, APPARATUS AND SOFTWARE
